acceptance_A.verdict: PASS for observed final-build native criteria; broader T55 and T72 scenarios remain partial

checks.release_artifact_identity: PASS: Chrome extensions details page initially showed stale 0.2.54; after clicking the extension Reload control, it showed 0.2.56, expected ID, and exact unpacked path. Independently recomputed unpacked tree hash matched release-receipt.json.
checks.admin_account_and_org_after_reload: PASS: Chrome's full extension Reload was followed by a 30-second wait before opening actual sidepanel.html. Settings showed admin@admin.com / ADMIN immediately. The organization section was expanded in a separate observation about 5 seconds later and showed ZZZ APPROVAL-TAIL throwaway a2c8a05f — safe to delete selected. No sign-in or account/organization mutation occurred.
checks.devtools_protocol_row: PASS: Advanced agent capabilities showed DevTools Protocol (debugger) as included with the extension and explained Chrome cannot turn it off in Settings; there was no interactive switch.
checks.optional_permission_states: PASS: Cookies, Page archive (MHTML), Clipboard read, and Tab video capture were all OFF in the actual side panel. No permission toggles were changed.
checks.about_identity_and_saved_login_readiness: PASS: after the account/organization observation, About showed Browser Chrome, Installed version 0.2.56, expected extension ID, and Browser APIs for saved logins Available.
checks.about_update_check: PASS for the observed no-update outcome: afterward, the read-only Check for extension update returned ‘Your browser did not find an update right now.’

inventory_case_effect.EXT-F-1003-T55: Observed required DevTools Protocol row and all four optional permissions OFF on 0.2.56. Denial, grant/removal, and persistence paths were not exercised, so the broad case remains partial/unverified.
inventory_case_effect.EXT-F-1003-T72: Observed admin About identity, saved-login readiness, and no-update result on 0.2.56. API-unavailable and update-available/throttled/error outcomes were not exercised, so the broad case remains partial/unverified.

acceptance_A.evidence_method: Direct native Chrome accessibility-tree observations from CUA; no screenshot or raw browser transcript was saved. Exact visible outcomes are recorded above.

source_state.delta_after_receipt_source: Two documentation-only stabilization files; no product source changes after the 0.2.56 release source SHA.

engineering_B.scope_note: This lane independently checked the shipped artifact and native acceptance only; it did not conduct an engineering code review or rerun release gates.

limitations: The full scenario matrix for EXT-F-1003-T55 and EXT-F-1003-T72 remains unverified; only the final-build criteria listed above passed.
The currently inspected Chrome extension is the unpacked 0.2.56 candidate; this run does not independently verify Web Store installation or production behavior.
No account, organization, permission, chat, or protected-capture state was changed.
